displayName: ASPIRE Preceptor Student Progress & Readiness Feedback

intro.heading: Student Progress & Readiness Feedback
intro.body: Thank you for precepting an ASPIRE student. This feedback supports the student's development and readiness as they prepare to transition into professional nursing practice. Specific examples are especially helpful. Any endorsement you provide is for consideration only and is not a hiring decision. The confidential section is reviewed by the ASPIRE team and unit leadership. This survey does not replace real-time coaching during the shift.
intro.compliance_note: Endorsement reflects whether you would endorse this student for consideration. It is not a hiring decision, job offer, interview guarantee, or placement guarantee.

section1.title: Student and Preceptor Details
section1.instructions: Names and unit are pre-filled from the ASPIRE record where known.

shifts_observed.label: Approximate Number of Shifts Observed With This Student

section2.title: Clinical Progress and Competency
section2.instructions: For each area, choose the rating that best reflects this student's current level. Comments with specific examples are encouraged.

clinical_judgment.label: Clinical Judgment
clinical_judgment.prompt: The student notices relevant patient cues, interprets changes appropriately, prioritizes needs, seeks help when appropriate, and reflects on actions to improve care.

patient_centered_care.label: Patient-Centered Care
patient_centered_care.prompt: The student provides compassionate, respectful, individualized care and considers patient preferences, values, culture, dignity, and comfort while applying classroom knowledge at the bedside.

safety_quality.label: Safety and Quality
safety_quality.prompt: The student prioritizes patient safety, follows policy and supervision expectations, minimizes risk, asks clarifying questions when unsure, and contributes to safe, evidence-informed care.

teamwork_communication_collaboration.label: Teamwork, Communication, and Collaboration
teamwork_communication_collaboration.prompt: The student communicates respectfully with the healthcare team, gives and receives information appropriately, seeks guidance when needed, and demonstrates awareness of team-based care.

professionalism_accountability.label: Professionalism and Accountability
professionalism_accountability.prompt: The student demonstrates accountability, punctuality, preparation, ethical behavior, receptiveness to feedback, appropriate boundaries, and commitment to learning.

advanced_beginner_readiness.label: Growth Toward Advanced Beginner Readiness
advanced_beginner_readiness.prompt: The student is progressing toward the expected advanced beginner level for a senior nursing student preparing to transition into professional nursing practice.

strengths_observed.label: Strengths Observed
strengths_observed.prompt: What strengths have you observed in this student? Please include specific examples when possible.

areas_for_development.label: Areas for Development or Coaching
areas_for_development.prompt: What areas should the student continue to develop? Please frame feedback in a constructive way and include examples or suggestions when possible.

suggested_support_plan.label: Suggested Support Plan
suggested_support_plan.prompt: What support, coaching, experiences, or learning opportunities would help this student continue progressing?
examples: practice communicating with the interprofessional team

transition_readiness.label: Based on your observations, how would you describe this student's readiness for transition into professional nursing practice?
options: Progressing, with continued focused support recommended

unit_endorsement_consideration.label: If this student applied for a position on your unit, would you endorse them for consideration?
options: Yes, with focused support or continued development

endorsement_explanation.label: Please explain your endorsement recommendation.
endorsement_explanation.prompt: Please include strengths, development needs, or conditions for success. If you selected "Not at this time" or "Yes, with focused support," please describe what support or growth would strengthen the student's readiness.

cedars_consideration_recommendation.label: Would you recommend this student for consideration within Cedars-Sinai, even if not necessarily on your specific unit?
options: Yes, with focused support or continued development

best_fit_environment.label: If applicable, what type of unit, environment, or preceptor style may help this student be successful?

confidential_comments.label: Confidential comments for ASPIRE team or unit leadership
confidential_comments.prompt: This section is not intended to replace real-time coaching. If the student needs feedback related to clinical performance, professional behavior, or patient safety, please provide timely feedback during the shift and notify the ASPIRE team as needed. Use this space for confidential context, concerns, or recommendations that should be reviewed by the ASPIRE team or unit leadership.

attestation.label: I confirm this feedback is based on my direct observations and is intended to support student development, safe practice, and transition readiness.
